source: Destatis, GENESIS-Online table 12612-0101 "Lebendgeborene: Bundesländer, Monate, Geschlecht" (retrieved via the public GENESIS-Online web API, no login). 2024 and 2025 final (status e), 2026 provisional (status p).
basis: residence of mother (Wohngemeinde der Mutter); month of occurrence
notes: July 2026 (provisional, latest month) dropped: Germany total July 2026 = 59,241 vs 61,099 in July 2025 (-3.0%) against -1.1% for Jan-Jun, with several Laender showing -6% to -15% in July, consistent with late registrations still to come. Provisional months are revised up as late registrations arrive (Destatis note). Bremen monthly figures are volatile. Finer (Kreis/NUTS3) data exist only annually in the Regionaldatenbank, which needs a login.

source: INSEE, statistiques de l'état civil – 'Naissances mensuelles depuis janvier 2024', release of 1 Oct 2026 (file NAIS_AN_DEP_REG_2026_08.xlsx, sheet Départements: annual births and births 1 Jan–end of reference month by département of residence of the mother). 2026 provisional.
basis: residence of mother; date of occurrence
notes: All years in this file are by département of residence of the mother (the monthly web tables used place of registration for 2024, but this file is residence for all years). Births of mothers resident abroad ('99 Hors de France') excluded. Jan-Aug 2026 kept: comparing the July-2026 vintage (Jan-Jul 2026 = 371,203) with the August vintage (Jan-Jul = 371,269) shows revisions of only +0.02%, so the latest month is essentially complete.

source: ISTAT, Bilancio demografico mensile (monthly demographic balance of the resident population, from municipal population registers), SDMX dataflow 22_315_DF_DCIS_POPORESBIL1_2 "Monthly data", DATA_TYPE=LBIRTH (live births), SEX=total. 2025 and 2026 provisional.
basis: residence (births registered in the municipal population register of residence); monthly flows of the population register (registrations), which may lag the date of birth slightly
notes: Latest available month is June 2026 (Jun 2026 vs Jun 2025: -0.9%, in line with Jan-May -0.7%), so it was kept. Sardinia: provinces were redrawn in 2026 (new codes IT113 Gallura Nord-Est Sardegna, IT119 Sulcis Iglesiente, ITG2A Ogliastra, ITG2B Medio Campidano; Sud Sardegna IT111 discontinued), so 2026 YTD is given for the region ITG2 only; 2025 vs 2024 uses the pre-2026 provinces (= NUTS 2021 ITG2D-ITG2H). ISTAT area codes differ from NUTS 2021 for the North-East/Centre (ISTAT ITD*/ITE* = NUTS ITH*/ITI*) and newer provinces; the nuts field gives the NUTS 2021 code, istat_code the original.

level: NUTS3 (provincia); Illes Balears at NUTS2 ES53, Canarias at NUTS2 ES70
source: INE, Estimación Mensual de Nacimientos (EMN), table 46682 "Nacimientos mensuales y acumulados. Total nacional, CCAA y provincias" (INE Tempus API). 2024 = definitive MNP figures; 2025 and 2026 = EMN estimates (corrected for late registration). Release of 16 Sep 2026 (data to July 2026).
basis: province of residence of the mother (EMN methodology: published by residence since May 2024; residence imputed from place of registration when missing); month of birth
notes: 2025 is an EMN estimate, not yet a definitive/provisional MNP count, compared against definitive 2024. Latest month July 2026 kept: EMN figures are already grossed up for under-registration (Jul 2026 +2.9% y/y vs +1.8% for Jan-Jun). Illes Balears is one province but three NUTS3 islands, so given as NUTS2 ES53. The Canary Islands provinces do not match NUTS3 islands; regions[] uses the CCAA total (ES70), and canarias_provinces gives the two provinces with their member NUTS3 islands. Births to non-resident mothers are in the national total only.

source: CBS StatLine table 37230ned "Bevolkingsontwikkeling; regio per maand" (OData API), topic LevendGeborenKinderen_2 (live births), COROP regions. 2024-2025 definitive, 2026 provisional; table modified 30 Sep 2026.
notes: Latest month 2026MM08 kept (Aug 2026 -1.7% y/y vs +1.0% for Jan-Jul; NL births must be registered within days, so lag is small, but it is provisional). COROP aggregates in this table follow the current municipal classification (e.g. Weesp moved from Het Gooi en Vechtstreek to Groot-Amsterdam in 2022), which can differ slightly from NUTS 2021 boundaries.

source: GUS, Bank Danych Lokalnych (BDL) API, variable 59 "Urodzenia żywe - ogółem" (subject P1873), unit level 4 (podregiony = NUTS 2021 NUTS3), years 2024 and 2025 (annual).
basis: place of permanent residence of the mother
notes: Only annual data could be retrieved. No 2026 year-to-date regional births found: BDL half-year/quarter variables (63216-63220) end in 2025; GUS "Sytuacja społeczno-gospodarcza województw" 2/2026 (10 Sep 2026) and Biuletyn Statystyczny 8/2026 contain only annual-2025 regional or national monthly vital statistics. The GUS territorial publication for 30 June 2026 (with H1 2026 births by voivodeship/powiat) was not yet out.

source: SCB Statistikdatabasen, BE0101G: MBefStatRegionCKM / TAB6473 "Befolkningsstatistik efter region och kön. Månad 2025M01-2026M08" (2025-2026) and ManadBefStatRegion / TAB1625 (2000M01-2024M12), förändringar=115 födda, both sexes.
basis: county of residence (population register); month of event
notes: From reference year 2025 SCB adds small controlled random noise to every cell (Cell Key Method), so 2025-2026 county figures are perturbed by a few units; 2024 figures are not. Latest month 2026M08 kept (Aug 2026 +0.6% y/y, in line with Jan-Jul +0.7%). 2026 figures preliminary.

source: Statistics Norway (SSB) StatBank table 01222 "Befolkning og kvartalsvise endringar" (quarterly), variable Fodte2 (live births), counties. Retrieved via SSB PxWeb API.
notes: Quarterly data only (latest 2026Q2), so the 2026 period is Jan-Jun. Norway re-split its counties on 1 Jan 2024; the 2024 counties were summed back to the NUTS 2021 units: Viken NO082 = Østfold+Akershus+Buskerud, Vestfold og Telemark NO091 = Vestfold+Telemark, Troms og Finnmark NO074 = Troms+Finnmark. Per-county figures are in county_detail. Svalbard/unknown had 0 births.

source: Statistics Denmark StatBank: BEV107 "Befolkningens udvikling" (annual, final; 2024 and 2025) and BEV22 "Befolkningens udvikling (foreløbig opgørelse)" (quarterly, preliminary; 2025K1-2026K2), movement B02 Levendefødte, both sexes, by kommune; kommuner aggregated to NUTS 2021 NUTS3 with the Eurostat LAU 2023-NUTS 2021 correspondence.
basis: municipality of residence (CPR population register); quarterly/annual
notes: Regional data are quarterly (latest 2026Q2), so 2026 period is Jan-Jun; both 2026 and 2025 H1 come from the same preliminary quarterly table BEV22. Full-year 2025 vs 2024 uses the final annual table BEV107.

source: Statistics Finland StatFin: synt/12dv "Vital statistics by month and area, 1990M01-2025M12" (final; 2024, 2025) and vamuu/11lk "Preliminary vital statistics by area, 2026Q1*-2026Q2*" (preliminary), live births by municipality; municipalities aggregated to NUTS 2021 NUTS3 with the Eurostat LAU 2023-NUTS 2021 correspondence.
basis: municipality of residence (Population Information System); monthly (final) / quarterly (preliminary)
notes: Regional preliminary data exist only by quarter (2026Q1-Q2), so 2026 period is Jan-Jun. The 2026 numerator is PRELIMINARY while the 2025 Jan-Jun base is FINAL (from 12dv); preliminary counts are usually revised slightly upward, so the ratio is if anything slightly understated. National preliminary monthly table 11ll runs to Aug 2026 but has no regional breakdown.

source: Statistik Austria, "Bevölkerungsveränderung nach demographischen Komponenten und administrativen Gebietseinheiten" 01.01.2025-01.01.2026 (BevVeraend_Komp_Gebietseinh_2025.ods, created 29.06.2026) and 01.01.2024-01.01.2025 (BevVeraend_Komp_Gebietseinh_2024.ods), column Lebendgeborene, section NUTS 3-Regionen. Final annual results; totals 76,067 (2025) and 77,238 (2024) match the vital-statistics press releases of 22.05.2026 and 26.05.2025.
basis: residence of mother (Hauptwohnsitz); includes births abroad to resident mothers
notes: No 2026 year-to-date regional births found: Statistik Austria publishes births by month and Bundesland only in annual tables (latest year 2025, file neu_Geborene_nach_demographischen_Merkmalen.ods, Tabelle 5); no provisional 2026 monthly or quarterly regional births were found on statistik.at or in the OGD catalogue (STATcube was not tried, it needs an account/API key).

level: NUTS3 (NUTS 2021; Grande Lisboa + Península de Setúbal summed to PT170 AML)
source: INE Portugal (Statistics Portugal) JSON API: indicator 0012436 "Nados-vivos por Local de residência da mãe (NUTS 2024), Sexo e Mês de nascimento; Anual" (final 2024 and 2025, updated 30 Apr 2026) and indicator 0012094 "Nados-vivos por Local de residência da mãe (NUTS 2024) e Sexo; Mensal" (preliminary Jan-Jul 2026, registrations up to 11 Sep 2026, updated 18 Sep 2026).
basis: residence of mother; month of birth
notes: Data are published on NUTS 2024 regions. The NUTS 2024 NUTS3 units match NUTS 2021 except that AML (PT170) is split into Grande Lisboa (1A0) and Peninsula de Setubal (1B0); these were summed. A check summing the 2025 municipality data to NUTS 2021 with the Eurostat LAU-NUTS 2021 file reproduced every NUTS 2021 total exactly. July 2026 dropped: preliminary July 2026 was -3.1% y/y vs -1.1% in June and between +4.7% and -0.8% earlier, so it may be incomplete. The 2026 numerator is preliminary while the 2025 Jan-Jun base is final. Mothers resident abroad excluded. Full-year 2025 vs 2024 was built by summing municipalities to exact NUTS 2021 units. For 2026 the monthly preliminary data exist only at NUTS 2024 NUTS3 level; in NUTS 2024 the municipalities of Sertã and Vila de Rei (about 127 births in 2025) moved from Médio Tejo (PT16I) to Beira Baixa (PT16H), so the 2026 PT16H/PT16I entries use NUTS 2024 boundaries (target and base on the same boundaries).

source: CZSO DataStat API: OBY01B "Základní údaje o stavu a pohybu obyvatel - roční údaje" (final 2024, 2025), OBY01A "... čtvrtletní kumulace" (final Q1-Q2 2025) and OBY01PD "Stav a pohyb obyvatel - předběžné údaje" (preliminary Q1-Q2 2026), indicator Živě narození (live births), kraje.
basis: residence (permanent or long-term residence, as published by CZSO); quarterly cumulative
notes: Regional data are quarterly cumulative (latest Q1-Q2 2026), so 2026 period is Jan-Jun. The 2026 numerator is PRELIMINARY (OBY01PD) and the Jan-Jun 2025 base is FINAL (OBY01A); earlier preliminary vintages cannot be retrieved without authentication.

source: KSH (Hungarian Central Statistical Office) STADAT table 22.2.2.1 "Élveszületések vármegye és régió szerint, negyedévente kumulált" (nep0067).
basis: residence of mother (as published by KSH); quarterly cumulative
notes: Regional data are quarterly cumulative (latest 2026 Q1-Q2), so the 2026 period is Jan-Jun. 2026 figures are preliminary. National Jan-Jun 2026 = 34,312 vs 35,015 (matches the KSH press release: 703 fewer, -2.0%). The sum of the counties is below the published national total for 2024 (76,741 vs 77,511), 2025 (71,500 vs 72,017) and Jan-Jun 2025 (34,769 vs 35,015), but not for Jan-Jun 2026 (34,312 = 34,312). The national total presumably also counts births whose mother lives abroad or in an unknown place, which the preliminary 2026 data do not yet assign. The county ratios use county figures only. Because of this, the 2026 county ratios may run about 0.7 points high on average: the county-sum ratio is 0.987, against 0.980 for the national total.
